subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should maintainers accept replacing the `dist-runtime-build` tar step with the new pack-and-smoke artifact script for this PR?
rationale: The patch is focused and well proven, but it changes the CI artifact producer and its smoke runtime path, which is an operational merge-risk choice rather than an author-side code defect.

options.title: Accept with exact-head proof
options.body: Land after confirming the current head or merge queue still passes the artifact producer and smoke checks; this is the recommended path because the PR directly fixes the linked artifact bug.

options.title: Require one more artifact rerun
options.body: Ask for an additional merge-queue or maintainer-run artifact proof if the CI producer cost or environment sensitivity needs fresh confirmation.

options.title: Pause the producer change
options.body: Hold or close only if maintainers do not want the CI artifact packaging step to own extracted-runtime smoke validation.

recommendation.title: Accept with exact-head proof
